flow.project.v2.Project.description:
Project is a business-scoped container of tasks. The workspace layer is
gone in v2: every project belongs directly to the caller's business,
resolved server-side from auth, and no request carries a tenant or
workspace identifier.

archived_at.description: archived_at is when the project moved to the recycle bin. Empty while active.

code.description: Short project code used to build Task.identifier (e.g. "FLW" -> "FLW-42").

color.description: color is the color value for this contract.

completed_count.description: Number of tasks with status="done". Display projection, ignored on writes.

created_at.description: created_at is when the record was created.

created_by.description: created_by is the created by value for this contract.

description.description: description is the description value for this contract.

due_date.description: due_date is the due date value for this contract.

icon.description: icon is the icon value for this contract.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the resource.

is_personal.description:
is_personal marks the caller's auto-provisioned My Tasks bucket. The
bucket is hidden from shared lists and exempt from manager-visibility
policies unless its owner explicitly shares it.

member_count.description: Count of project members, for the "+N" avatar stack. Display projection, ignored on writes.

name.description: name is the name value for this contract.

owner_id.description:
owner_id is the user who created the project. Not the tenant: the
business is implicit from the caller's auth context.

purge_at.description:
purge_at is when the recycle bin will permanently delete this project and
everything inside it. Stamped at archive time from the business's
retention setting; later retention changes affect future archives only.

start_date.description: start_date is the start date value for this contract.

status.description: status is the current lifecycle state.

task_count.description: Total task count for this project. Display projection, ignored on writes.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the record was last updated.

visibility.description:
visibility controls discoverability. "private" (default) limits the
project to its creator and members; "public" additionally exposes the
fields of this message on the owner's profile to business colleagues.
Public never grants task access by itself.

visible_via_report.description:
visible_via_report is true when the caller can see this project ONLY
because they manage someone involved in it (the dept-manager proxy), and
not because they created it, own it, or are a member.

It exists so a client can group these separately without asking per
project why each one is visible. It is a per-caller projection, not a
property of the project: the same project is false for its own members and
true for their manager. Never persist it.

cost_minor_units.description:
cost_minor_units is the labour cost of billable logged time in the
smallest unit of the business currency, so no rounding happens before
the caller sees it.

costed_minutes.description:
costed_minutes is billable logged time whose contributor had a rate on
record; it is the time included in cost_minor_units.

uncosted_employee_count is how many distinct contributors have no rate
on record.

uncosted_minutes.description:
uncosted_minutes is billable logged time whose contributor has no rate
on record. A total with uncosted_minutes above zero understates true
labour cost and must be labelled as partial where it is displayed.

delete.description:
purgeProject immediately and irreversibly deletes an archived project and
everything inside it, including attachment files. Server-gated to the
project creator and business admins.

archiveProject moves the project to the recycle bin. It is reversible via
restoreProject until purge_at passes.

get.description:
getProjectLabourCost returns the labour cost of billable logged time on a
project. Requires admin on the project: it exposes aggregate spend, and
the aggregate is derived from HR rates that must not leak through Flow.
